capabilities: append notes to today's Daily Note
create missing Daily Notes from templates
add file attachments as vault links
review notes and tasks in a timeline
extras: Bilingual Japanese and English UI with automatic language detection; recommended setup section advises keeping Daily Notes enabled and advanced tools hidden for quick capture.
problem: Obsidian has no fast input surface for jotting everyday notes and tasks; they must be written directly into the right note and file.
summary: Quick-capture plugin that appends short notes and tasks to today's Daily Note and lets you review them in a timeline.
